{{Top|leg}}
The '''TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated Administration Center''' was a building located on [[Central Avenue]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Grig]] on the [[Planet/Legends|Planet]] [[Narg]]. It was connected to the [[Grig Employee Training School]] and [[TGM Hospital]] via walkways and incorporated the use of [[cablelift]]s. It oversaw all [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]] activity on the planet, and was under the leadership of [[Braig Farool]].<ref name="The Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
